title: 🔆🔅**Third Supertanker Struck in Strait of Hormuz in Two Days**
text:
🔆🔅**Third Supertanker Struck in Strait of Hormuz in Two Days**"

"According to the Public Relations Office of the Navy of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC):"

"🔹 This morning, October 12, the third offending supertanker was struck in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire."

"🔹 This tanker, by switching off its navigation system and ignoring warnings from the IRGC Navy, intended—like previous violators—to exit the Strait of Hormuz and disrupt its order and security; it was therefore struck."

"🔹 The IRGC Navy announces: Any cooperation by commercial vessels and oil tankers with the terrorist and smuggler army of the aggressive and plundering United States in the Strait of Hormuz and the Persian Gulf region will be met with our decisive response."

"Source: IRGC
